improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon: a Claude-powered assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-image.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://gdn.ai/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon is, who it serves, and the free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the price anchor (US$2/day) sets expectations and qualifies clicks. These tags are foundational SEO elements that directly impact organic discovery and social sharing performance.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately names the product and defines its role, reducing confusion. The subheading highlights three concrete benefits (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) and ends with a clear, low-commitment CTA that leverages the free trial offer to drive engagement without pressure.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own members workspace. Choose monthly billing or save 30 percent with an annual plan.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the trial-to-paid conversion point, reducing friction by clearly explaining what happens next. It reinforces value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace) and highlights the low entry price and annual savings, making the upgrade feel accessible and worthwhile.
